author: Good Enough
description:
If a Komodo dragon attacks you, reacting the wrong way could make the situation far more dangerous.

Komodo dragons are massive predatory lizards with powerful jaws, sharp claws, and venom that can quickly weaken their prey. This video explains what to do during a Komodo dragon attack, the mistakes that can make the encounter worse, and how to improve your chances of escaping safely.

This Short breaks down survival tips for one of the most dangerous reptiles on Earth.
title: If a Komodo Dragon Attacks You, Do This 🦎😲 #animals #wildlife #survival #facts
